newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 9.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The Shanghai branch of the People's Bank of China, the central bank, is taking measures to reduce the bad debts of state-run banks.
- The recent batch of state debt is selling well in Shanghai with 42.23 percent of the amount planned for the city having been sold so far.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) rose by a year-on-year 13.5 percent to 68.63 billion yuan in the first quarter of this year.
- Shanghai is aiming to achieve $14.5 billion in exports in 1997, up 10 percent from 1996.
